prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER: use ONLY its elegant delicate thin black contour lines, slight organic variation, sparse detail and large white areas. Do NOT copy its Buddha subject. Images 2 and 3 show the actual DAXIONG HALL of FENGGUO TEMPLE 奉国寺大雄殿, Yixian, Liaoning, built in 1020. They are SUBJECT GEOMETRY only. Image 2 is the front facade but its extreme panorama bends the geometry and the low angle hides much of the roof. Use its facade's NINE bays (seven central door bays flanked by one blank wall bay at each end), front columns, and front bracket rhythm. Image 3 is an oblique exterior view giving the complete broad roof silhouette and substantial raised platform; use it for the roof's full height and HIP form, not for replacing the front openings with rear details.
Create a straight-on, calmly symmetrical front elevation of only the main Daxiong Hall, preserving its exceptionally wide nine-bay facade and ONE monumental low-pitched HIP ROOF 庑殿顶 with deep eaves and two large curved ridge-end ornaments. This is not a hip-and-gable roof, no exposed gable triangles and no second eave tier. Resolve lens and panorama distortion into correct upright columns and a straight horizontal facade. All nine structural bays must remain legible: ten column axes, seven central tall door groups, two outer closed plaster-wall bays. Keep actual graceful shallow eave curvature, overhanging corners, large multi-arm bracket sets and massive height-to-width proportions. Draw the complete roof including ridge and both tips; show a simple unbroken raised rectangular plinth beneath, without inventing a huge front stairway or porch. Exclude the small pavilion or covered corridor visible in image3. No neighbouring roofs, no ceremonial vessels, no incense burner, no railing, no poles, no trees, no tourists, no signs or plaques. Remove all text entirely.
Refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. Confident very fine contours, few even finer internal structural lines. Match the master visual density. All surfaces stay WHITE, even doorways. Only simplified door frames and a few fine lattice suggestions; no filled black windows. Roof planes remain largely blank with just 12-16 widely spaced thin slope contours and selective ridge outlines, never a dense tile grid or complete brickwork. No thick ink, shadows, grey wash, hatching, crosshatching, pencil grain, weathering texture, gradient, color or gold. No labels, calligraphy, watermarks, captions, borders or framing.
Landscape 1536 x 1024. Entire isolated main hall centered at about 82 percent of canvas width, with balanced breathing room on all four sides. Roof and platform uncut. Only a few short ground lines. Architecture comes from the real photos; do not copy surrounding structures or invent additions.

site_recommendation.coordinate_note: 寺院近似位置，非单体测绘坐标。
site_recommendation.lede: 义县古城里，奉国寺大雄殿把九间立面铺展在一整片庑殿屋顶之下。七尊辽代彩塑佛像并坐殿内，与梁架上的飞天彩画相对；木构、塑像和彩绘共同保存了十一世纪的营造面貌。
facts: 奉国寺始建于辽开泰九年（1020），现存主体大雄殿为辽代建筑。
大雄殿面阔九间、进深五间，单檐庑殿顶，殿前中央七间开门。
1961年列入首批全国重点文物保护单位；殿内保存七尊辽代彩塑佛像及辽代梁架彩画。
